home.title: Katswiri Wathunthu Wokhazikika | Product & Systems
home.descriptionA: Katswiri wamkulu wodzaza zinthu zonse wazaka 6+ akutenga zinthu kuchokera pazofunikira zosamvetsetseka kupita ku machitidwe odalirika opanga. Ndimapanga zomanga kuseri kwa React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, ndi SQL application: malire omveka bwino, mitundu yokhazikika ya data, njira zolowera zotetezeka, ndi magulu operekera njira amatha kugwira ntchito molimba mtima.
home.descriptionB: Ntchito yanga imagwirizanitsa zisankho zaumisiri ndi zotsatira zabizinesi. Kuchokera ku SaaS yoyerekeza yomanga yomwe imatembenuza zidziwitso zamasamba kukhala malingaliro okonzekera kasitomala ku nsanja zopangira ndalama, ndimapanga mapulogalamu mozungulira kayendetsedwe ka ntchito, chiopsezo, ndi mtengo woyezera womwe umafunikira kwa anthu omwe akuugwiritsa ntchito.

personal_summary.title: Chidule Chaumwini
personal_summary.text: Ndine mainjiniya wamkulu wokhazikika ku Orlando, FL yemwe ali ndi njira yochokera ku vuto lazogulitsa kupita ku zotsatira zopanga. Ndimapanga zisankho zaukadaulo pothandizira dongosololi: .NET ndi Entity Framework Core pomwe domeni yokhazikika komanso yoyeserera yoyeserera; Angular kapena React pamene zovuta mayendedwe amafunikira mawonekedwe osungika; Node.js kapena Go pamene API, kuphatikiza, kapena chida chapamwamba chikufunika nthawi yothamanga. Pazinthu zonse za SaaS, mayendedwe amkati, ndi nsanja zoyang'ana makasitomala, ndimatsogolera ndi malonda omveka bwino, mapangidwe otetezeka komanso okhazikika, kuyesa pawokha, ndi njira zoperekera zomwe thandizani magulu kutumiza mapulogalamu ofunikira osasiya ngongole zogwirira ntchito.

entries.title: Full Stack Engineering
entries.text: Ndimayang'anira kutumiza kwazinthu kumapeto-kumapeto: kumasulira mayendedwe abizinesi kukhala malire adongosolo, mitundu ya data, ma API, ndi malo olumikizirana, kenako ndikugwira ntchitoyo poyesa, kutumiza, ndi kubwereza. Cholinga chake ndi mapulogalamu omwe gulu lingathe kusintha ndikugwira ntchito, osati kusonkhanitsa zowonetsera zochotsedwa.

entries.title: Zomangamanga za Product & Platform
entries.text: Ndimasankha mapulaneti ndi machitidwe kutengera vuto: layered .NET services for business domains, component-driven Angular or React applications for complex operations, relational zitsanzo za data zamayendetsedwe oyankha, ndi kuphatikiza kopangidwa ndi njira zolephereka, kuwongolera mwayi wofikira, ndi kusungitsa m'malingaliro.

entries.title: Kutumiza Kokonzeka
entries.text: Ndimamanga ndi zowona nditatha kukhazikitsidwa: zinsinsi zomwe sizimayendetsedwa ndi gwero, njira zakusamuka zachinsinsi, chilolezo chotengera maudindo, kutsimikizika pamalire adongosolo, zoyeserera zokha, kuzindikira kwa CI/CD, komanso kuwonetsetsa kothandiza. Izi ndizomwe zimasinthira prototype kukhala mapulogalamu odalirika.

biblioteca.title: Biblioteca JSON
biblioteca.text: Chitoliro chokhazikika cha Python chomwe chimasintha gwero limodzi lokhazikika kukhala malo opezeka padziko lonse lapansi. Imagwira ntchito zomasulira ngati njira yosungika m'malo mochita kukopera masamba pamanja, zomwe zimalola tsambalo kuti lizikula m'zilankhulo zoposa 100 ndikupangitsa kuti padziko lonse lapansi kufikire uthenga wabwino. kuthekera kogwiritsa ntchito m'malo mwa nthawi imodzi.

connect_four.title: Gwirizanitsani Zinayi
connect_four.text: Banja lalikulu la kukhazikitsidwa kopitilira 50+ kwamasewera a Connect Four. Ntchitoyi ikuphatikiza kukhazikitsidwa m'zilankhulo zopitilira 30, kuphatikiza Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, ndi zina. Kuphatikiza apo, imaphatikizanso mitundu yopitilira 20+ kapena mitundu ina, kuphatikiza React.js, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET, ndi zina zambiri.

grocery_app.title: Grocery App
grocery_app.text: Pulogalamu yathunthu ya NET 9 Blazor Server yomwe imawonetsa mamangidwe adala kumbuyo kwa kayendetsedwe ka bizinesi. Kugawanika kwa olamulira / ntchito / chosungira kumasunga malamulo ogwiritsira ntchito, kupeza deta, ndi kuwonetserako mopanda kuyesedwa; Entity Framework Core imapereka kulimbikira kokhazikika; ndi comprehensive test suite imateteza machitidwe pamene zinthu zikusintha.

interop.title: Pulogalamu ya Interop
interop.text: Kulumikizana kwa zilankhulo zosiyanasiyana komwe kumatengera zilankhulo 15 zamapulogalamu ndi machitidwe 18. Pulojekitiyi imafufuza malire omwe machitidwe nthawi zambiri amakhala osalimba: makontrakitala okonza, kusinthana kwa data, machitidwe othamanga, ndi njira zobwerezabwereza zophatikizana. Imawonetsa malingaliro amachitidwe omwe amafunikira ngati chinthu chili chachikulu kuposa stack imodzi.

inventory_register.title: Register ya Inventory
inventory_register.text: POS yodzaza ndi zida zonse zomangidwa ndi Angular 17+ ndi Node.js. Imawonetsa zovuta zogwirira ntchito za dongosolo la B2B: ogwiritsa ntchito otsimikizika, kuwongolera kotsata njira, kulondola kwazinthu, komanso kubweza kwachipongwe. Pulojekitiyi idapangidwa mozungulira ntchito yeniyeni yomwe gulu lolembetsa limagwira, osati mndandanda wazinthu zamadongosolo.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Auto Formatter
formatter.text: Chida chovomerezeka cha JSON ndi YAML chozikidwa pa msakatuli ndi masanjidwe opangidwa mu Go ndikupangidwa ku WebAssembly. Kusuntha injini yoyimitsa mu WASM kumapangitsa kuti kulumikizana kukhale koyankhidwa komanso komweko kwa msakatuli kwinaku mukugwiritsa ntchito chowerengera chenicheni kuti mugwire zolowa zosavomerezeka. Ndi chitsanzo chokhazikika pakusankha kamangidwe ka nthawi yoyendetsera ntchito, kusuntha, komanso kudalira kwa ogwiritsa ntchito.

takeoff_engine.title: Injini yoyambira
takeoff_engine.text: Kuyerekeza kwa SaaS yomanga yomanga mozungulira mayendedwe okwera mtengo, omwe amakhala ndi zolakwika. Chogulitsa cha React + Express chimalowetsa data ya CSV ndi Excel, imayika mizere yosagwirizana kukhala mtundu wogwiritsiridwa ntchito, kuwerengera kukumba ngalande ndi kuchuluka kwa nthaka, kutsata ntchito ndi ntchito. markup, ndikupanga ma PDF okonzeka ndi kasitomala ndi Mawu. Uwu ndi uinjiniya wanthawi zonse wazinthu zonse: kusanthula deta, malamulo owerengera, kayendedwe kantchito kopukutidwa, ndi zoperekedwa zomwe zimathandiza bizinesi kuchoka pabizinesi kupita kubizinesi.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON Jenereta
minecraft_json_generator.text: Jenereta yopepuka ya JSON yomangidwa mu Python ya Minecraft zothandizira & mapaketi a data. Pulojekitiyi imagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga mafayilo a JSON a ma mods a Minecraft, kuphatikiza zinthu zokhazikika, midadada, ndi mabungwe. Zothandiza kwambiri osati kungopanga ma datapacks, koma ma mods komanso kudzera pakusintha dzina la mod.

educational_experience.title: Maphunziro Anga
educational_experience.text: Pamodzi ndi ntchito zanga zanga, ndaphunziranso maluso ambiri kuchokera ku maphunziro. Dinani apa kuti muwone mbiri yanga ya LinkedIn kuti mudziwe zambiri.

professional_experience.title: Katswiri Wanga
professional_experience.text: Zaka zisanu ndi chimodzi kuphatikiza zaukadaulo waukadaulo pamagulu azogulitsa, nsanja zamabizinesi, ndi mapulogalamu omwe amayang'ana makasitomala. Ntchito yanga yaphatikizira kupanga magawo ogwiritsiridwa ntchito bwino, kugwirizanitsa njira zoperekera, ndikupanga zisankho zaukadaulo ndi moyo wazinthu, magwiridwe antchito. chiopsezo, komanso umwini wanthawi yayitali.

portfolio_website.title: Webusaiti ya Patrick Goodwin Portfolio
portfolio_website.text: Dongosolo lopanga la React lomwe limayang'anira kupezeka ndi kufikira padziko lonse lapansi ngati zofunikira zauinjiniya. Mulinso njira yomasulira yokhazikika ya zilankhulo 100+, zida zogwirizanirana mothandizidwa ndi WebAssembly, ma UI omvera komanso ofikirika, komanso kamangidwe ka polojekiti. zokonzedwa kuti zikule pamene ntchito yatsopano ikutumizidwa.

lua_library.title: Patrick's Lua Script Library
lua_library.text: Laibulale yothandiza ya zolemba za Lua kuti zigwiritsidwe ntchito mtsogolo. Laibulaleyi imagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga ntchito m'malemba a Lua, omwe amatha kugwira ntchito zofunika kwambiri, chifukwa Chilua nthawi zambiri chimakhala chilankhulo chofulumira kuposa Python ndi Ruby.

excel_scripts.title: Patrick's Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet Scripts (VBA)
excel_scripts.text: Laibulale yothandiza ya zolemba za VBA za Microsoft Excel. Laibulale iyi imagwiritsidwa ntchito kupanga ntchito mu Excel spreadsheets.

neovim_config.title: Patrick's Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: Kusintha kwanga kwa Neovim. Pulojekitiyi imagwiritsidwa ntchito kukonza Neovim momwe ndimakonda, kuphatikiza zomangirira, mitu, ndi mapulagini. Pulojekitiyi imagwiritsidwa ntchito kuti Neovim ikhale yosavuta kugwiritsa ntchito komanso yothandiza kuti ndigwiritse ntchito ndekha.

python_maps.title: Patrick's Map Generator
python_maps.text: Chida chofotokozera za Python geospatial chomangidwa ndi GeoPandas ndi Matplotlib kuti apange mamapu aku US ndi mayiko. Imatembenuza zidziwitso zapamalo kukhala zowunikira zowerengeka, kuwonetsa malingaliro a mapaipi a data: sankhani malaibulale oyenerera, sinthani zolowetsa, ndikupanga zotuluka zomwe thandizirani zisankho zomveka bwino.

powershell_library.title: Patrick's PowerShell Script Library
powershell_library.text: Laibulale yothandiza ya zolembedwa za PowerShell kuti mugwiritse ntchito mtsogolo. Zothandiza ndi mawonekedwe a $profile script, ndimapeza kuti izi ndizothandiza kwambiri pakupanga ntchito kuchokera pa Windows terminal, chifukwa ndimakonda kugwiritsa ntchito Windows OS.

ruby_library.title: Patrick's Ruby Script Library
ruby_library.text: Laibulale yothandiza ya zolemba za Ruby kuti zigwiritsidwe ntchito mtsogolo. Zothandiza pamalingaliro amtsogolo a Ruby pa Rails.

pdf_builder.title: Wopanga Maluso a PDF
pdf_builder.text: Mayendedwe opangira zikalata opangidwa ndi Python, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML, ndi data yokhazikika ya JSON. Imalekanitsa zidziwitso zomwe zingagwiritsidwenso ntchito ndi ma tempuleti owonetsera kuti apange ma PDF ogwirizana nthawi zonse, njira yothandiza yochepetsera ntchito zamanja ndikupanga zolemba zamabizinesi. zobwerezedwa.

rijandel_encryption.title: Rijandel Encryption Project
rijandel_encryption.text: Gulu lofananiza la 10+ Rijndael kukhazikitsa pamitundu yonse ya 128-, 192-, ndi 256-bit. Kukhazikitsanso ma aligorivimu okhudzana ndi chitetezo m'zilankhulo zonse ndi njira yodziletsa mwatsatanetsatane, machitidwe oyesera, ndi malire a kutha kwa chilankhulo, nzeru zonse zothandiza kwa machitidwe amene amasamalira deta tcheru.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minecraft Mod
suprememc.text: Minecraft Mod yomwe imawonjezera zida zamakono, zida, magulu a anthu, midadada, miyeso, ndi zina zambiri pamasewera. Zomangidwa ndi mitundu ya Java 8-17 pazosankha za Minecraft pakati pa 1.16 ndi 1.20.

tiger_programming_language.title: Chilankhulo cha Tiger Programming
tiger_programming_language.text: Chilankhulo chokhazikika komanso chomasulira chomwe chimapangidwa mu Go kuti mufufuze kamangidwe ka chilankhulo, machitidwe, ndi kusintha kwa magwiridwe antchito. Kuziphatikiza ku WebAssembly ndikuziphatikiza muzolemba kumapanga malo enieni, owoneka bwino aukadaulo wamakina m'malo mosiya ntchitoyo ngati ntchito. kuyesa kosungira kokha.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Tsamba la Tiger Tailgating Pros
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: Webusayiti ya React yoperekedwa ku bizinesi ya Clemson, SC. Ntchitoyi imatanthawuza kupereka kwabizinesi yaying'ono kukhala ulendo womveka wamakasitomala komanso kupezeka kodalirika pa intaneti, kugwiritsa ntchito malingaliro azinthu kuthandiza bungwe lenileni kusintha chidwi. kufunsa ndi ndalama.

turing_machine.title: Makina a Turing Project
turing_machine.text: Banja laopitilira 30+ akugwiritsa ntchito Makina a Turing. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito kuwonetsa kukwanira kwa zilankhulo zosiyanasiyana zopangira kafukufuku, makamaka pa Chiyankhulo cha Tiger Programming.

contact.title: Ndiuzeni Ine
contact.description: Ndimayankha mafunso kuchokera ku imelo ndi mauthenga a LinkedIn. Ndidzabweranso ngati nambala yanga iperekedwa kudzera mukuyambanso kapena ayi, ngakhale ndimakonda kusunga nambala yanga yachinsinsi.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Linter
formatter.description: Chida chamtundu wa asakatuli chomwe chimatsimikizira ndikusintha JSON ndi YAML pogwiritsa ntchito injini ya Go yopangidwa ku WebAssembly. Zomangamanga zimangoyang'ana pafupi ndi wogwiritsa ntchito kuti ayankhe mwachangu, mwachinsinsi kwinaku akukhazikitsa malamulo enieni a syntax pamalire a data. Ndi chitsanzo chophatikizika chopanga njira yodalirika yoyendetsera ntchito mozungulira kulondola, magwiridwe antchito, ndi kudalirika.
formatter.more_info1: Kuti mudziwe zambiri, onani README mu
formatter.empty_input: Chonde lowetsani JSON kapena YAML kuti mutsegule.
formatter.fixed_yaml_spacing: ⚠ YAML inali ndi masipatala/mapindikidwe olakwika koma idasinthidwa zokha ndikusinthidwa.

tiger.title: Chinenero cha Tiger
tiger.description: Kambuku ndi chilankhulo chokhazikika ndipo omasulira a Go adapangidwa kuti afufuze kamangidwe ka nthawi, chilankhulo cha chilankhulo, komanso kusinthana kwa magwiridwe antchito. Kuphatikizira womasulira ku WebAssembly kumapangitsa kuti makina azigwira ntchito molumikizana, pogwiritsa ntchito asakatuli: ogwiritsa ntchito amatha kugwiritsa ntchito mapulogalamu mwachindunji pomwe nthawi yothamanga imakhala yosasunthika. ndi kulekanitsidwa ndi pulogalamu yolandila.

global_accessibility.description: Mbiri yanga ikupezeka m'zilankhulo zopitilira {count}, zomwe zimapangitsa kuti alendo ochokera padziko lonse lapansi azifikirika. Njira iyi ya zinenero zambiri imasonyeza kudzipereka kwanga ku kuphatikizidwa ndi kufikira padziko lonse lapansi pakupanga mapulogalamu.
